# Security policy

The maintained security policy is [docs/014-security.md](../docs/014-security.md).

Please use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/djblack1209-coder/OpenClaw-Bot/security/advisories/new) when available. If unavailable, open an issue titled “Security contact needed” without sensitive details so the maintainer can arrange a private channel.

Do not publish credentials, account details, private logs, or exploit details in a public issue.
